result.summary: The pedestrian environment features basic infrastructure such as a marked continental crosswalk and a sidewalk, but it is situated in a wide, industrial-style corridor. interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility by placing pedestrians further into the driver's field of vision.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install high-visibility pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear guidance on crossing intervals.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Green Buffer
interventions.description: Add street trees or a planted buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway to provide physical separation and improve the pedestrian experience.
